questions.name: sgE-7355142-1-122
questions.question: Driving in a state of rage can:

options.text: Affect your ability to reason and make decisions
Increase the chance of being involved in a traffic accident
Lead to a revoked or suspended license
All of these choices

questions.name: sgE-7355142-1-118
questions.question: Which of the following may describe a work zone sign?

options.text: A white rectangle with black letters
An orange diamond with black letters
A green rectangle with white letters
A yellow circle with black letters

questions.answer_text: An orange diamond with black letters

questions.name: sgE-7355142-1-120
questions.question: What is true of work zones?

options.text: They are always stationary and therefore easily avoided
They are only dangerous at night
Speeding fines are tripled when workers are present
Rear-end collisions are the most common type of crash in work zones

questions.answer_text: Rear-end collisions are the most common type of crash in work zones

questions.name: sgE-7355142-1-124
questions.question: On long trips you can prevent drowsiness by:

options.text: Turning on your car radio
Slowing down so you can react better
Stopping at regular intervals for a rest
Moving your eyes from side to side as you drive

questions.answer_text: Stopping at regular intervals for a rest

questions.name: sgE-7355142-1-119
questions.question: Signs that warn "lane closed ahead" may indicate a work zone ahead. You should:

options.text: Merge your vehicle into the correct lane when it is safe
Drive to the end of the closed lane before attempting to merge
Understand that this sign is merely a suggestion and continue in the lane
Speed up to merge as quickly as possible

questions.answer_text: Merge your vehicle into the correct lane when it is safe

questions.name: sgE-7355142-1-121
questions.question: Which of the following is always true about road rage?

options.text: There is nothing a driver can do to prevent road rage
You must hold your position in your travel lane
Only violent people experience road rage
You should remain polite to aggressive drivers

questions.answer_text: You should remain polite to aggressive drivers

questions.name: sgE-7355142-1-127
questions.question: One of the rules of defensive driving is:

options.text: Look straight ahead as you drive
Stay alert and keep your eyes moving
Expect that other drivers will make up for your errors
Be confident that you can avoid danger at the last minute

questions.answer_text: Stay alert and keep your eyes moving

questions.name: sgE-7355142-1-129
questions.question: Minimum speed signs are designed to:

options.text: Keep traffic flowing smoothly
Show current local road conditions
Test future traffic signal needs
Assure pedestrian safety

questions.name: sgE-7355142-1-126
questions.question: A safe speed to drive your car:

options.text: Is the posted speed limit
Is less than the posted speed limit
Depends on the weather and road conditions
Depends on the mechanical skill of the driver

questions.answer_text: Depends on the weather and road conditions

questions.name: sgE-7355142-1-128
questions.question: On a New York State highway where there is no posted speed limit, the fastest you may legally drive is:

options.text: 50 mph
55 mph
60 mph
65 mph

questions.name: sgE-7355142-1-123
questions.question: Aggressive driving can become road rage. What should you do when confronted by an aggressive driver?

options.text: Speed up to pass the driver as quickly as possible
Be prepared to yield the right of way
Drink alcohol to calm yourself down
Make eye contact with the driver

questions.answer_text: Be prepared to yield the right of way

questions.name: sgE-7355142-1-125
questions.question: Seat belts can be most effective as injury preventive devices when they are worn by:

options.text: The person driving the car
Passengers when they are on a long drive
All occupants of a car being driven on an expressway
Passengers and the driver whenever they are in the car

questions.answer_text: Passengers and the driver whenever they are in the car
